requirements.description:
Have the following honors:
  a. Internet
  b. Computing IV - Advanced
What tools are needed to assemble and maintain computers?
What is a test or diagnostic card?
What care is needed when handling the internal components of computers?
What is static electricity? What risks does it pose? How can you keep it from damaging the computer's components?

Define what each of the following is and what processes it performs:
  BIOS
  Post
  Boot
Why is the motherboard considered the heart of the computer, and the processor its brain?

Using a real motherboard or a photograph, identify and state the function of:
  Processor socket
  Memory socket, and state its type
  Power supply connector
  Slots present, and state the bus type
  Chipsets
  IDE and/or SATA interface
  Case connectors for the front panel, audio, USB
State which memory module types (DDR2, DDR3, etc.) are currently used and which have the greatest potential capacity.
Explain the relationship between using high-capacity memory and low-performance computers.
On a hard drive, what are tracks, sectors, cylinders, clusters and bad blocks?
What are file (storage) systems? Name at least 3 and state the main differences between them.
What are the main differences between AT and ATX cases?
What is the CPU?
What is the processor clock?
What are hertz and how are they calculated?
Name at least 5 factors that determine the capacity of a processor.
What advantages were gained by changing components from the parallel connector (PATA) to the serial connector (SATA)?
Explain what the Setup configuration is, how to access it, and its main functions in computer assembly and maintenance.

Explain and carry out the following activities:
  a. Demonstrate the ability to assemble and disassemble a computer, identifying each internal component, stating its function and handling it properly.
  b. Explain what thermal paste is for and apply it correctly.
  c. Connect an off-board card and get it running, showing the performance improvement in that area.
  d. Format a computer's hard drive with a program of your choice.
  e. Partition the formatted hard drive into 3 partitions.
  f. Install a new operating system of your choice on the formatted hard drive, configure it and set it up for immediate use.
  g. Merge 2 of the 3 partitions.
  h. State the importance of each one and then install all the basic programs needed for home use of a computer.

Explain how to prevent, diagnose or fix the following problems:
  a. Dirty memory module
  b. Processor overheating
  c. Computer with no audio
  d. Does not get past the "black screen"
  e. Restarts repeatedly
  f. Viruses
